name: Happy Pappys Coffeehouse
description: Happy Pappys is a local, family-owned coffee shop founded by the Papadelias family. The business was inspired by a coffee shop the family discovered in Texas and opened in August 2019. They provide a premium third place where patrons can unwind, socialize, and recharge while enjoying high-quality coffee and delicious food. The shop survived Hurricane Sally and the COVID-19 pandemic in its first year of operation.
